sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/billings.json: read. It holds only remodelers, plumbers, supply stores and roofers, with no partition installers. Opened Walles Mountain Contracting (windows, doors, glass; no partitions) and Proper Contractors (proper-trades.com is under construction), and excluded both.
Bobrick find-a-rep: the page loads, but results need a dropdown that isn't readable without a browser. No Montana rep found.
ASI, Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco: not reached (search budget spent).
Procore Network public directory: WORKED and gave almost every candidate (Billings, Bozeman, Missoula, Great Falls and Helena 'interior' and 'specialties' category pages, plus profiles).

WebSearch, 7 of 7 used: toilet partitions / Division 10 / restroom partitions queries for Billings, Bozeman, Missoula, Helena and Great Falls. They returned mostly One Point Partitions (an online seller with Billings, Butte and Missoula delivery and office pages, installation not stated; its page returned 403), Southwest Solutions Group (demountable office walls only), SBI Contracting (Boise ID, a Division 10 firm but outside range), Montana State University spec manuals and BBB category pages. No local partition specialist turned up.

Excluded as too far or out of scope: Commercial Door & Specialties, Rapid City SD (Division 10 accessories and lockers, serves MT per Procore, but about 300 miles away); Commercial Contracting and Maintenance, Glasgow MT (northeast MT and western ND); Bloedorns, Miles City MT (supplier); Lime Tree Carpentry (Fort Collins CO); Digital Interior Group (Kent WA); Stevens Door & Specialty (garage doors).
Yelp, BBB, Google business listings: only BBB category pages showed up in search results, none relevant, and none were opened.
